shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Far left edge below left inlane, feeds the drain. Part of the SLAM lane set (letter overlay); no kickback on this machine.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Inside of right outlane, feeds right flipper. Part of the SLAM lane set.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Far right edge below right inlane, feeds the drain. Part of the SLAM lane set.

shots.name: Left Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard slingshot above the left flipper.

shots.name: Right Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard slingshot above the right flipper.

shots.name: SPACE Targets
shots.notes: Bank of 5 standups spelling S-P-A-C-E, lower-left playfield. Pairs with JAM targets to light Superjam.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Far left edge loop/orbit. Spots Roadrunner; lightable for Jackpot; part of Fast Break (5 shots).

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Sits upper-left, tucked alongside the left ramp. Spotting IN YER FACE letters is its day job, and it becomes the Super Jackpot target once multiball reaches wave 3.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Narrow jump-ramp (not a loop) — a low-percentage, hard-to-make shot. Feeds the main basket (top-left backboard hoop) via a jump shot. Starts Final Jam once all planets lit.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: 3-bumper cluster, upper-center. Feeds the REBOUND planet (25 hits).

shots.name: Monstars Drop Targets
shots.notes: Bank of 3 drop targets left-of-center, below the pop bumpers. 2nd completion triggers IN YER FACE.

shots.name: Super Duper Jackpot Target
shots.notes: One standup target at the top-center of the playfield, behind the bumpers. Lit for 15s during multiball wave 4; mostly reached via bumper rebounds.

shots.name: Wabbit Hole
shots.notes: Central mystery-award kickout saucer, lit by clearing both 23 targets. Known for aggressive bounce-outs.

shots.name: Jump Shot (Jump Ball lock lane)
shots.notes: Raised lane through a one-way gate, center-right. The lock shot and single most important shot in the game; feeds a VUK/magnet catch further upfield.

shots.name: Skill Shot Basket (Right Hoop)
shots.notes: Mini basketball hoop toy fed from the shooter/plunger lane, right side, labeled SKILL SHOT on the playfield. Skill-shot target only — a separate hoop from the main basket at the top-left, which is the basket-points, FIRE, and Final Jam collect target.

shots.name: Main Basket (Backboard Hoop)
shots.notes: White backboard, red-rim basketball hoop at the top-left of the playfield, reached via the left ramp jump shot (not the shooter-lane skill-shot hoop). The basket-points collect target, FIRE's supercharged 10-points-per-shot target, and the Final Jam collect shot.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Right side ramp. Spots FIRE letters (4 shots); lightable for Double/Super Duper Jackpot; Fast Break's escalating-value shot.

shots.name: 23 Targets
shots.notes: Pair of red standups flanking the right ramp entrance. Both lit = Wabbit Hole lights.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Far right edge loop/orbit, mirrors left orbit. Spots Tazmanian Devil; part of Fast Break.

shots.name: JAM Targets
shots.notes: Bank of 3 standups spelling J-A-M, lower-right playfield, mirrors SPACE bank.

shots.name: Plunger Lane
shots.notes: Standard shooter lane with spring plunger and software auto-launch; feeds directly toward the basket for the skill shot.

goals.title: Basket Skill Shot

goals.reward: Banks the DMD-selected award — 300K, Lite Lock, Wabbit Hole, or Super Pops

goals.title: League and Wizard Mode — Set Them at Start

drills.title: Cycle It, Then Bank It
drills.text: Tap a flipper while the ball waits in the lane to put the award you actually want on the display, then plunge into the hoop. Lite Lock is the one that feeds multiball, so cycle to it rather than taking whatever happens to be showing.

drills.title: Jump Shot Is Home Base
drills.text: Return every rebound to the Jump Shot lane and shoot nothing else. The first hit of a game lights all three locks at once, so four total makes is a multiball, and no other shot on this layout pays that well for the risk.

drills.title: Waves In Order
drills.text: Learn the running order cold: the ramps, then both orbits and the Jump Shot, then the captive ball, then the right ramp to arm the centre target. Every switch you hit along the way inflates what the later jackpots pay, so the order is also the reason not to rush.

drills.title: Left Ramp, When Nothing Is At Stake
drills.text: Work the left ramp on quiet balls rather than in the middle of something important. The sweet spot is narrow and a short one dies in the bumpers, but it feeds the main basket and it is the only shot that starts the wizard mode.

drills.title: Do Not Panic At The Countdown
drills.text: Take the centre Super Duper target only when you have a settled look at it, even with the clock running. There is no ball save here beyond the skill shot and the fixed post between the flippers rules out a death save, so a rushed shot costs far more than an expired window that the right ramp can relight.

drills.title: SLAM In Single-Ball Play
drills.text: Work all four in and outlanes while you still have one ball in play, since the letters cannot be spotted during a mode or a multiball. Reaching the top of the multiplier lights a free extra ball at the Jump Shot, which is where you already live.

actionButton.how: No cabinet button beyond the basics — a spring plunger, two flipper buttons, start. The flippers carry the extra duties: they scroll the skill shot award while the ball waits in the lane, holding both of them hands the plunge over to the machine (and still credits the award), and they pick your answer in the trivia mode.

howItPlays.objective: Space Jam (Sega, 1996) turns the table into a game of hoops against the Monstars. Light the seven planets to reach Final Jam, and run the four-wave jackpot multiball.
loop: Tap a flipper to scroll the pre-plunge skill-shot award you want, then launch into the mini hoop to bank it.
Hammer the Jump Shot lane -- the game's very first Jump Shot lights every lock at once, so four makes in all start Multiball.
Once multiball is running, follow the four jackpot waves in their fixed order and let switch hits inflate each payout.
Satisfy the seven planet objectives spread across the playfield, from SLAM in the lanes to a Super Jackpot in multiball.
With all seven planets lit, shoot the left ramp to start Final Jam.

lights.name: Skill Shot Basket
lights.lit: The mini hoop beside the shooter lane is the skill-shot target, and its display cycles four awards -- three hundred thousand, Lite Lock, Wabbit Hole, or Super Pops.

control.effect: a flipper tap while the ball waits in the shooter lane scrolls the display to the award you want, and holding both flipper buttons hands the plunge to the machine while still crediting that award

lights.then: Cycle to Lite Lock to feed multiball, then plunge the hoop to bank it. With points, Lite Lock, or Super Pops banked, a quick left-ramp shot within the window adds bonus basket points on top.

lights.name: Jump Shot Lock Lane
lights.lit: The raised Jump Shot lane matters more than any other shot here; the game's very first Jump Shot lights every lock at once, and it stays a jackpot shot during multiball.
lights.then: Make it four times to lock all three balls and launch Multiball, and treat it as home base by returning every rebound here. Reaching six-times bonus later opens a free extra ball at this same lane.

lights.name: Jackpot Waves
lights.lit: Multiball jackpots light in four fixed waves: both ramps for a Double Jackpot, then both orbits and the Jump Shot for the Jackpot trio, then the captive ball for the three-million Super Jackpot, then the right ramp arms the center target.
lights.flashing: The center Super Duper Jackpot target flashes for a fifteen-second window once the right ramp arms it; re-shoot the right ramp to relight it if that window runs out.
lights.then: Rack up spare switch hits as you go to swell every payout, then take the five-million Super Duper target last -- carefully, since a fixed center post leaves no room for a death save. Collecting it restarts the loop at wave one.

lights.name: SPACE & JAM Banks
lights.lit: The SPACE bank on the lower left and the JAM bank on the lower right stay lit until spelled; completing both lights Superjam and satisfies the SPACE JAM planet.
lights.then: Superjam is a forty-five-second chain -- hit every jackpot-geography shot once for a climbing award that opens at fifty thousand and adds a hundred thousand per new shot.

lights.name: Monstars Drops (IN YER FACE)
lights.lit: Knock down the three Monstars drop targets; a second full clear of the bank sets off IN YER FACE and opens the captive ball for a thirty-second window.
lights.then: Rattle the captive ball up to three times at a hundred fifty thousand each to finish the mode and satisfy the IN YER FACE planet.

lights.name: Right Ramp (FIRE & Fast Break)
lights.lit: Four right-ramp shots spell FIRE and supercharge the main basket to ten points a shot for twenty-three seconds; five shots to each orbit instead qualify Fast Break and turn the right ramp into a rising two-hundred-to-seven-hundred-thousand shot.
lights.then: Spell FIRE and unload on the main basket, or qualify Fast Break and hammer the right ramp -- each clears its own planet toward Final Jam.

lights.name: Wabbit Hole
lights.lit: Down both red 23 targets by the right ramp to light the Wabbit Hole saucer; diving in draws one of a dozen stacked mystery awards, and any you do not collect carry over ball to ball.
lights.then: Hope for Full Court Frenzy, a five-ball multiball with all six arrows lit behind a long ball save, or the smaller 2 on 2 Multiball -- the saucer also hides a ball-catch mini-game and a Jordan trivia quiz.

lights.name: SLAM Lanes & Pops
lights.lit: Rolling all four in-and-outlanes spells SLAM to step the bonus multiplier up, and lifetime pop-bumper hits grind toward the REBOUND planet.
lights.then: You can only spell SLAM in single-ball play -- not in a mode, not in a multiball -- so wrap the lanes up early; reaching six-times bonus opens a free extra ball over at the Jump Shot lane, and enough pop hits clears REBOUND.

scoring.text: Cycle the skill shot to Lite Lock and bank it at the hoop, then treat the Jump Shot as home base -- its opening hit lights every lock, so four makes is the quickest multiball here. Pick up SLAM, SPACE and JAM only as they come to you.

Work the seven planet objectives -- FIRE at the right ramp, IN YER FACE off the Monstars drops, REBOUND in the pops, Fast Break through the orbits -- and light the Wabbit Hole off the 23 targets for a shot at Full Court Frenzy.

Light all seven planets and start Final Jam at the left ramp: a sixty-second, five-ball finale where every switch builds a running pot and each basket make collects it. Underneath it, the four-wave jackpot loop ending in the five-million Super Duper Jackpot is the multiball payoff.
